protocols.title: High Voltage Safety
rules: Always disconnect and lock out power before working on electrical components
Verify zero voltage with meter after disconnecting - don't trust the disconnect alone
Discharge all capacitors before touching - they hold lethal charge even after power off
Use insulated tools rated for the voltage you're working with
Never work alone on high-voltage systems - have someone nearby for emergencies
Wet conditions: do NOT work on electrical components - reschedule
Test your meter on a known live source before trusting a 'dead' reading

protocols.title: Refrigerant Safety
rules: EPA Section 608 certification required to purchase and handle refrigerants
Never vent refrigerant to atmosphere - federal violation, $44,539 per day fine
Recover refrigerant into approved DOT cylinders only
Disposable cylinders must NOT be refilled - transport violation
R-32 and R-454B are A2L (mildly flammable) - no open flames, use ventilation
Refrigerant displaces oxygen - never work in enclosed spaces without ventilation
Liquid refrigerant contact causes frostbite - wear gloves and safety glasses
Never use oxygen or compressed air to pressure test - explosion hazard
Use dry nitrogen only for pressure testing (with appropriate regulator)

protocols.title: Rooftop/Ladder Safety
rules: 3-point contact rule on ladders at all times
Ladder angle: 4:1 ratio (1 foot out for every 4 feet up)
Secure ladder at top - tie off or have someone hold
Carry tools in belt or bucket - keep hands free for climbing
On flat roofs: watch for soft spots, skylights, and unmarked openings
Hot roofs in summer: wear appropriate footwear, stay hydrated
Wind above 25 mph: postpone rooftop work
Harness required at heights above 6 feet (OSHA standard)

protocols.title: Gas Line Safety
rules: If you smell gas: evacuate area immediately, do NOT operate any electrical switches
Soap bubble test all gas connections after work
Gas line pressure test: 3 psig for 10 minutes minimum (manometer test)
Verify gas valve off before working on heat exchanger or burners
Check heat exchanger for cracks: visual + carbon monoxide test in supply air
CO level above 9 ppm in supply air = cracked heat exchanger = SHUT DOWN unit
Never bypass safety switches (rollout, high limit, pressure switch)
